sections.title: التمرين 76/A – اكتب بريدا الکترونيا من 100 إلي 120 کلمة أخبار صديق عن شركة أنشأتها مؤخرا

items.q: Write an email of 100-120 words telling a friend about a company you have recently set up with a friend or relative. The company could be producing one of the following: jewellery, cosmetics, perfume, food or footwear.
items.answer:
A cosmetics company
Hi Layla,
I'm so excited to tell you about my new news that my cousin and I just started a small cosmetics company! We make natural handmade face serums using honey and rosewater from Kurdistan. Last month, we showed our products at a fair in Erbil, and people loved them! We're working hard to add more products and hope to sell online soon. I'd really like you to try our products and tell me what you think. You're great at giving good ideas, so maybe you can help us with marketing too! Let me know if you're interested.
Best wishes
Sara

sections.title: التمرين – اقرأ المقالة في الصفحة 43 من كتاب الطالب وأجب عن الاسئلة التالية

items.q: 1. Why is it now easier for people to work out from home?
items.answer: It's easier thanks to new technologies and equipment.

items.q: 2. What are some ways technology has changed fitness?
3. How do modern fitness apps help people track their workouts?
items.answer: They can measure how fast your heart is beating, how many calories you burn and how well you sleep.

items.q: 4. Who do gym owners have to compete with nowadays?
items.answer: They have to compete with online and home gyms.

items.q: 5. Where can people use workout mirrors to improve their exercise routines?
items.answer: They can use them at the gym because they are too expensive to buy.

sections.title: التمرين 81/D – تدرّب علي جمل الندم باستخدام I wish / if only وکذلک الشرطية الثالثة

items.q:
1. I'm not feeling very well.
Well, you did have six slices of cake! I bet you wish you (not eat) so much now.

2. Mum said she'll be here in about an hour.
We'll have to wait then. If only I (not forget) my key when I left home.

3. I can't believe you're going to be an aunt!
I know! If only I (not throw away) my old toys. I could give them to the baby.

4. Did you see the prices of the tickets to the concert now?
Yeah. Now I wish I (buy) them earlier, when they were cheaper.

5. I can't believe we're lost! And no phone signal!
If you had listened to me, you (bring) the map.

sections.title: التمرين 82/A – أكمل هذه الجمل للتعبير عن الندم

items.q: 1. I didn't buy the jacket while it was on sale.
items.answer: If only I had bought the jacket while it was on sale.

items.q: 2. My dad didn't check the oil, and the car broke down.
items.answer: The car wouldn't have broken down if my dad had checked the oil.

items.q: 3. Qais didn't make a copy of his essay, so he had to write it all again.
items.answer: If Qais had made a copy of his essay, he wouldn't have had to write it all again.

items.q: 4. Hazem spent all his money on video games.
items.answer: Hazem wishes he hadn't spent all his money on video games.

items.q: 5. I didn't pay attention in class and failed the exam.
items.answer: I wish I had paid (more) attention in class. I wouldn't have failed the exam.

items.q: 6. I didn't take many photos of my trip.
items.answer: If only I had taken (more) photos of my trip.

items.answer: I would have moved to a different seat. / If the bus had been full, I would have complained to the driver.

items.q: 2. Salima invited two friends to dinner on Saturday. They came on Friday.
items.answer: I would have cooked something for them. / If I hadn't had any food, I would have taken them out for a meal.

items.q: 3. Safia broke her friend's beautiful glass vase. She decided not to say anything about it and hid the pieces.
items.answer: I would have told the truth. / If they'd been very upset, I would have bought another vase.

items.answer: I would have complained to the manager. / If the manager had been rude, I would have told everybody in the restaurant about my meal.
